question: Decide the implicit and explicit user intent expressed in the user prompt in the context of this chat. State it in fewer than 100 words. <string> (less than 100 words): ${userIntent}

A user intent always includes a desire to change data. Examine ${userIntent}. List the files that contain the data the user wants changed. For file creation, list the names that will be given to the created files. <Array<filename>>: ${targetFiles}
List the locations of the data that will be changed in ${targetFiles}. <Array<{"filename": <filename>, "frombyte": <integer>, "tobyte": <integer>}>>: ${targetData}

For each location in ${targetData}, list the specific words in ${userIntent} that require that change. <Array<{"location": {"filename": <filename>, "frombyte": <integer>, "tobyte": <integer>}, "intent": <string>}>>: ${targetDataIntent}

There is not one heuristic for handling every user intent. Choose one mode from three options for handling ${userIntent} this time. Does the intent require correcting or checking a prior failure, disputed result, unsupported claim, or adherence to a prescribed procedure where compliance must be explicitly demonstrated? If yes, choose accountability. Otherwise, does the intent require carrying out operations, changing data, using tools, or producing a concrete deliverable? If yes, choose fidelity. Otherwise, choose minimal. Accountability is triggered by the need to demonstrate correspondence between requirements, actual actions, and evidence; fidelity is triggered by faithful performance of the requested work without that additional accountability requirement. <"accountability" | "fidelity" | "minimal">: ${mode}
